description: Proposed, typed action contracts derived from candidate capabilities. Every contract starts proposed and unapproved; none may execute until the owner confirms it and a native HQ implementation passes its verification.

contracts.title: Match paths with a glob pattern
contracts.description: Return the bounded set of paths under an approved root that match one glob pattern.
contracts.verification: Fixture with three files: pattern *.js returns exactly the expected set, sorted; no writes and no spawn.

contracts.title: Enumerate a directory tree
contracts.description: Return sorted relative paths under an approved root with explicit ignore rules and a hard file cap.
contracts.verification: Fixture tree returns the exact sorted path list; a symlink loop does not recurse; the file cap is reported.

contracts.title: Resolve a path or module
contracts.description: Resolve one path or module name to an absolute location, or return a typed not-found result.
contracts.verification: Known and missing fixtures both return typed results; resolution never spawns a process or touches the network.

contracts.title: Split front matter from a document
contracts.description: Parse structured front matter and return data plus body without evaluating the body.
contracts.verification: Valid fixture yields data and body; invalid YAML returns a diagnostic rather than throwing an untyped error.

contracts.title: Parse argv into typed options
contracts.description: Parse a bounded argv array with declared flags, aliases and defaults.
contracts.verification: Fixture argv yields defaults, aliases and unknown-flag diagnostics; environment variables are not mutated.

contracts.title: Normalize an object against a schema
contracts.description: Apply declared normalizers and validators to a plain object and return a canonical object.
contracts.verification: Fixture object normalizes deterministically; an invalid value returns a typed field error; a second pass is idempotent.

contracts.title: Persist namespaced configuration
contracts.description: Set and read a namespaced value inside an approved workspace path with an explicit write scope.
contracts.verification: Set then get a value in a temp workspace; the written path and content hash appear in a receipt; owner confirmation is required.

contracts.title: Normalize a package manifest
contracts.description: Read one package.json and return normalized name, version, license, main, bin and dependency fields.
contracts.verification: Fixture manifest normalizes to the expected fields; malformed JSON returns a typed error; nothing is written.

contracts.title: Compose asynchronous steps
contracts.description: Run two or more in-process async functions in a declared order with error propagation.
contracts.verification: Two fixture steps run in order; a thrown error stops the chain and is returned typed; no process is spawned.

contracts.title: Run a registered task list
contracts.description: Register named tasks and run a task or a sequential task list under a hard timeout.
contracts.verification: Denied by default; after owner confirmation and an allowlist entry, a dry run lists tasks and a fixture task runs with a receipt. Never network or browser.

contracts.title: Load a template collection
contracts.description: Load named templates from an approved directory into an inspectable collection.
contracts.verification: Fixture collection loads with the expected names and count; loading performs no rendering and no writes.

contracts.title: Render a template string
contracts.description: Render one template with a plain data object and a bounded helper set.
contracts.verification: Fixture render matches the expected output hash; a missing variable produces a diagnostic; helpers cannot read the filesystem.

contracts.title: Scaffold files from a template
contracts.description: Plan target paths and write files only inside an approved directory after a dry run.
contracts.verification: Dry run prints every target path and writes nothing; apply writes only inside the approved root and emits a per-file receipt; traversal outside the root is refused.

contracts.title: Store bounded key/value state
contracts.description: Set, get and delete small values in an HQ-owned store with a namespace and a size cap.
contracts.verification: Set/get/delete round-trip in the HQ database; no path outside .hq is written; value size cap is enforced; a receipt records the key.

contracts.title: Inspect a dependency tree
contracts.description: Read a lockfile and return package nodes and dependency edges without installing anything.
contracts.verification: Fixture lockfile yields the exact node and edge counts; no install, no network, no execution of package code.

contracts.title: Compare semantic versions
contracts.description: Evaluate whether a version satisfies a declared range and return a typed result.
contracts.verification: A fixture matrix of ranges and versions returns the expected booleans; no network access.
